# JUJU Films (LLMs and AI Agents Catalog)
> JUJU Films is a creator collective based in India, specializing in mobile-first vertical micro-dramas (9:16), premium OTT original series, and brand-enabled intellectual property.

This file provides a structured index of the JUJU Films website, capabilities, and automated tools for LLMs, crawlers, and AI agents.

---

## Machine-Readable API Catalog
For programmatic access to JUJU Films content, the following read-only REST endpoints are available:

- **Services/Capabilities**: [GET /api/services](https://www.jujuindia.com/api/services) - Returns a list of our core capabilities.
- **Recent Blogs**: [GET /api/blogs](https://www.jujuindia.com/api/blogs) - Returns published blog posts (accepts `search` and `limit` query parameters).
- **Case Studies**: [GET /api/case-studies](https://www.jujuindia.com/api/case-studies) - Returns campaign success stories and metrics.
- **Blog Categories**: [GET /api/categories](https://www.jujuindia.com/api/categories) - List of categories for blog categorization.

The API specification is documented in [OpenAPI Specification](https://www.jujuindia.com/openapi.yaml).

---

## Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
JUJU Films provides an MCP server for AI assistants (like Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor) to search local content and submit contact leads.

- **File**: `mcp-server.js` (Root of repository)
- **Execution Command**: `node mcp-server.js`
- **Capabilities & Tools**:
  - `get_services`: Exposes detailed company divisions and VMD framework definitions.
  - `search_blogs(query, limit)`: Performs an active search on published blog articles in our Supabase instance.
  - `search_case_studies(query, limit)`: Active search on influencer campaign case studies.
  - `submit_contact_request(type, first_name, email, message, ...)`: Submits a lead directly into the CRM database.

- **Home**: [https://www.jujuindia.com/](https://www.jujuindia.com/) - Main entry point.
- **About**: [https://www.jujuindia.com/about](https://www.jujuindia.com/about) - Story, team, and creative philosophy.
- **Vertical Micro-Drama Production**: [https://www.jujuindia.com/vertical-micro-drama-production-india](https://www.jujuindia.com/vertical-micro-drama-production-india) - Overview of VMD production, frameworks, and pilot series.
- **VMD Playbook**: [https://www.jujuindia.com/vertical-micro-drama-production-india/playbook](https://www.jujuindia.com/vertical-micro-drama-production-india/playbook) - Our story design, hook mechanics, casting, pre-production, and launch playbook.
- **Case Studies**: [https://www.jujuindia.com/case-studies](https://www.jujuindia.com/case-studies) - Portfolio of IP and client collaborations.
- **Blog**: [https://www.jujuindia.com/blog](https://www.jujuindia.com/blog) - Creative insights, VMD trends, and production tips.
- **Start Project (Contact Form)**: [https://www.jujuindia.com/start-project](https://www.jujuindia.com/start-project) - Inbound funnel for Brands and Creators.
